# Tests a local (devel) build keeps the "// muxt version:" line of an
# existing generated file, so go generate does not churn the header and the
# MuxtVersion method between developers and CI.
#
# Under `go test` the muxt binary reports "(devel)".

# No file yet: the running version is recorded.
muxt generate
grep '^// muxt version: \(devel\)$' template_routes.go

# A file generated by a tagged release keeps its version.
cp tagged.txt template_routes.go
muxt generate
grep '^// muxt version: v0\.20\.0$' template_routes.go
grep 'const muxtVersion = "v0\.20\.0"' template_routes.go
! grep '\(devel\)' template_routes.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.25
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /"}}
	<h1>Hello!</h1>
{{end}}
-- template.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSrc embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSrc, "*.gohtml"))
-- in.go --
package main

func main() {}
-- tagged.txt --
// Code generated by muxt generate . DO NOT EDIT.
// muxt version: v0.20.0

package main
